newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong exchange closed for New Year holiday.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong exchange closed for New Year holiday.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong will be closed for the New Year's Day holiday on Wednesday.
Trading will resume as normal on Thursday, January 2.
The blue-chip Hang Seng Index last closed at 13,451.45, down 29.30 points on Tuesday's half-day session.
The Hong Kong Futures Exchange will also be closed and trading in Hang Seng Index futures, sub-index futures and options will resume on Thursday.
